name: What is the average cost of pre-listing home improvements for a typical property?

mainEntity.name: What is the average cost of pre-listing home improvements for a typical property?

acceptedAnswer.text: The average cost of pre-listing home improvements varies widely based on the home's size, condition, and the extent of work. Minor updates like painting and landscaping might range from a few hundred to a few thousand dollars, while larger projects could be tens of thousands. To get a realistic estimate, we recommend obtaining at least three quotes from licensed contractors for each planned project. Your Kelby Contreras agent can help you manage these costs by advising on high-impact, budget-friendly updates for your market.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary significantly; minor updates are hundreds to thousands, major projects can be tens of thousands. Obtain multiple contractor quotes, and your agent can advise on budget-friendly, high-impact options.
